description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management system. It generates an HTML page displaying test cases with associated Custom Fields and execution data, including links for editing, executing, and viewing histories. It interacts with the database to retrieve test case info, custom fields, execution results, and constructs an interactive data table.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: An external table class used to generate and manage HTML tables with advanced features like grouping and sorting.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument object containing user-selected or session-based parameters for the test case report.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with page titles, labels, test case prefixes, and status mappings.

methods.name: buildResultSet
methods.description: Retrieves execution data and custom field values from the database and populates the result set in the GUI object.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines the structure and headers of the data table, optionally including platform info and custom fields.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has the necessary rights on the project.
